name: Hot Cheese Dip
description: A creamy bacon and cheddar dip baked inside a pumpernickel bread shell.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the pumpernickel loaf and hollow it out, leaving a thick shell.
Mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, and bacon bits until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the hollowed-out bread.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil, leaving the hole with the cheese mixture uncovered.
Bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.
Serve hot with the bread pieces.

keywords: pumpernickel dip, hot bacon dip, cheddar dip

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Fruit Dip
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful cream cheese dip infused with orange juice and marshmallow creme, ideal for fresh fruit.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients in a dish and beat until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with fresh cut-up fruit.

_similar.keywords: fruit dip, orange cream cheese, marshmallow dip

_similar.name: Spinach Dip
_similar.description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

_similar.keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread

_similar.name: Quick Garlic Fingers
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful appetizer featuring garlic-infused margarine on flatbread topped with a blend of cheddar, mozzarella, and Monterey Jack cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the margarine, garlic salt, oregano, basil, and thyme together until well combined.
Spread this mixture evenly on the cheese flat bread.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar, mozzarella, and Monterey Jack cheese over the top.
Place in a preheated oven at 350°F for approximately 10 to 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the edges are slightly golden and crusty if desired.

_similar.keywords: garlic fingers, cheesy bread, quick appetizer

_similar.name: Chili Brie in Sourdough
_similar.description: A sourdough loaf stuffed with molten Brie cheese and seasoned with a smoky chili spice blend.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Combine chili powder, mustard, garlic powder, and sugar; set aside.
Cut a circle in the top of the bread and remove the center to make room for the Brie.
Spread butter inside the bread cavity and sprinkle with 2 tsp of the spice mixture.
Remove the rind from the Brie and place it inside the bread.
Sprinkle the Brie with the remaining spice mixture and replace the bread top.
Bake on a baking sheet for 20 to 30 minutes.
To serve, remove the top and break it into bite-sized pieces; dip bread pieces into the hot Brie.

_similar.keywords: chili brie, sourdough brie, melted cheese appetizer
